steps.title: PostgreSQL Transition Rules / History Integrity
steps.description: Confirm lifecycle transition rules and history rows exist under RLS-forced schema
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relname IN ('lifecycle_transition_rules','lifecycle_history','lifecycle_status','lifecycle_requests') AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Transition Blocked
steps.description: Unauthenticated POST on administrative transition contract returns HTTP 401
